title: 도깨비 야식 포장마차
description: 달빛 개울가의 흥겨운 도깨비 포장마차에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.
scene: A cheerful Korean folklore fantasy night snack stall beside a moonlit stream, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. A striped fabric canopy shelters a warm wooden counter, with a small stone bridge, reeds, and deep indigo hills in the background. At the upper-left canopy post, one clearly visible small wooden goblin club hangs horizontally, with one large round coral-red ornament fixed to its tip. In the lower-left foreground, a rectangular charcoal brazier holds exactly five clearly separated food skewers in one neat row. At the center of the counter sits one round brass kettle with a large clearly visible jade-green lid. In the lower-right foreground, one cream ceramic plate has one large simple cobalt-blue crescent motif painted in its center. At the upper-right corner hangs one large warm paper lantern ending in a clearly visible straight gold tassel. Include two friendly rounded goblins enjoying skewers and savory pancakes, plus the recurring small friendly blue-robed goblin guide holding a softly glowing crescent lantern. Add plain bowls, a folded cloth, a small pancake griddle, reeds, stepping stones, and fireflies only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the club-tip ornament, five skewers, kettle lid, plate motif, and lantern tassel large, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. Do not include any readable writing, letters, numbers, seals, or calligraphy.
style: original premium Korean folklore storybook game illustration inspired by the warmth, flat decorative rhythm, and tactile paper quality of traditional Korean folk painting without copying any specific artwork or artist; clean expressive ink contours, soft cel shading, subtle hanji paper texture, polished animated-feature background quality, friendly rounded goblins, crisp object silhouettes, cohesive deep indigo, moonlit cream, warm amber, dancheong teal, coral red, muted jade, cobalt blue, and gold palette
changeGuidance: Make only these five changes: 1) change the large coral-red round ornament on the tip of the hanging wooden goblin club at upper-left to turquoise blue, 2) remove exactly one skewer from the lower-left brazier so four remain, 3) change only the jade-green lid of the brass kettle at center to purple, 4) change the cobalt-blue crescent motif in the center of the lower-right cream plate into a cobalt-blue five-petal flower of similar size, 5) change the straight gold tassel under the upper-right paper lantern into a clearly forked two-tail gold tassel. Preserve every goblin, all food, stall, canopy, counter, stream, bridge, reeds, fireflies, camera, crop, lighting, palette, texture, and every other object exactly. Do not make any additional changes.
